Info.methodologyBody: Apps with explicit official support wording are listed as supported. Other apps are listed as unsupported with an unverified-evidence label.

statusDescriptions.supported: Official sources confirm that Duo support is available now.
statusDescriptions.planned: Duo support has been officially announced but is not available yet.
statusDescriptions.unknown: No support evidence has been confirmed for this initial listing. This is not an official statement of non-support; the status will change when evidence is verified.
statusDescriptions.unsupported: The developer has stated that the app does not support Duo.

Info.evidenceBody: We check App Store Duo support badges, release notes, developer documentation and Apple announcements, including supported versions and release dates. General iPhone or iPad compatibility and search snippets alone do not confirm Duo support.
Info.reviewBody: We update information after checking support wording and sources. The update date records publication of the information, not a device test. Missing release notes or fetch failures do not remove existing evidence.
Info.regionBody: We cover apps and versions available in South Korea. Switching to English does not change the store region.

Import.title: Import apps
Import.description: Import app information from the South Korea App Store as drafts. Review support information and sources before publishing.
Import.urlInput: South Korea App Store links (one per line)
Import.urlHelp: Enter up to 200 South Korea App Store links at a time.
Import.csvHelp: Use a UTF-8 CSV file with up to 200 rows and a size of 512 KiB or less. The app_store_url column is required; source_url, proposed_status, evidence_summary, announced_at and support_version are optional. If you choose a file, it is used instead of pasted text.
Import.runningHelp: Importing apps in order. If you stop, the current item will finish and be saved.
Import.resumeHelp: Check any row errors before importing. You can also resume a stopped import.
Import.missingEvidence: Support evidence is incomplete. Add official sources, or record a reason if publishing as “Needs verification.”
Import.proposalHelp: This information has not been reviewed. Check the official source before adding it to the evidence fields above.

Submission.title: Request an app or correction
Submission.intro: Tell us about a missing app or incorrect information. Reports are private. We check official sources before updating an entry.
Submission.privacy: Do not include names, contact details or other personal information. A temporary cookie helps limit repeated reports.
Submission.receivedBody: We will check your report and sources. Only confirmed information will be added to the app entry.
